definitions.ask: Should `\` still type `#` in the four field spots where `/` stays literal (`=\`, `[[note\`, `=/a\`, `=*a\`)?
definitions.why: You asked to migrate `\` to `%`; one meaning per key is easier to remember.

choices.label: `\` only ever types `%`; in those four spots you type `#` by hand
`\` types `%` at directive spots and `#` only where `/` cannot; one key, two meanings

definitions.ask: Should the Capture Alias glossary strand be corrected to say `/` types `#` and `\` types `%`?
definitions.corrects: `\` or `/` → `#` wherever a `#` menu would open
